commits.message: Harden file upload/extraction: size+page caps, sanitized exceptions, temp-file cleanup
Add DB connection hygiene, encryption at rest, and path validation
Mitigate prompt injection in LLM system/user prompts
Add centralized error logging; clear plaintext key in run-roleiq.ps1
Fix overclaiming UI text, Role Context indicator, and silent pause_turn cap
Pin dependency versions and harden run-roleiq.ps1 script hygiene
Add pytest suite for pure-logic functions
Add CI workflow and Streamlit safe-defaults config
Add role-analysis contract validation and fix misleading provider status
Convert UI from free-form tabs into a guided wizard/LMS flow
Add go-live protocol Phase 0-2 artifacts: recon, status, requirements, architecture
Complete Phase 3: SDLC audit (hard gate) -- 32 suites, 36 findings
Complete Phase 4: go-live roadmap -- 31 GL items across 8 sprints
